summary: Single Metrocount piezo counter (378) on the Pittwater Rd shared path at North Narrabeen, running continuously from 2024-12-10 to 2026-09-20 with one record per slot, a stable North/South split (about 1.1:1) and no gaps. The only changes are two zero_outage fixes on the North direction (2025-06-30..07-03 and 2025-09-09..11) that removed real wet-weather lows mirrored exactly by the South direction; these should be restored. No series definition is needed.
